name: Villa Rosa
description: In Bloemfontein there is a guest house where the walls have ears and where there is daily drama, intrigue and also a lot of comedy.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: The first ever episode of Villa Rosa

videos.title: Episode 169
videos.overview: Bento connects the world! Discover a universe of bento from Japan and around the world, with step-by-step instructions and delicious tips and tricks!

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Petrus daydreams about Carlo's lots of money - little does he know how much trouble it causes. Nadine misses her parents but Hamish is planning something special for her.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Sussie realises that something is wrong but Fran doesn't have the courage to tell her. Then she finds out the reason that Lerato's been avoiding her and confronts JP.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: Fritz and Lerato orchestrate a masterpiece with the help of Anthony and Marius - which Petrus and Wouter are oblivious to. Vicky plays Carlo's counsellor regarding his relationship with Isabel while Carlo brings Vicky relief. Sussie, Daniel and JP forge forward. Who will win Sussie's heart?

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Marius is discouraged by Vicky who doesn't want to give up water birth. Astrid plays with Stef's feelings but he remains strong. Sussie gives Daniel and JP an ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Sussie insists that JP and Daniel have to sort out their differences while Marius tries to catch out Vicky with her water birth.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Carlo freaks out when Vicky practices contractions and Isabel decides she should go on maternity leave. Vicky unsuccessfully tries to say something to Marius while JP and Daniel's forced attempt to be friends ends up in the splash pool.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: What does Vicky desperately need to talk to Marius about and why does his innocent suggestion upset her so? Carlo's swept away by "Mario"'s glamorous life and apparent experience when it comes to investing.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Sussie wants to throw Vicky a surprise baby shower but she soon realizes it's not going to be easy. Fran is frustrated with the "circumstances" in King Pie.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Daniel uses his morning with Sussie fully - to such an extent that she's exhausted! Sussie tries to find out what everyone can give Vicky for her baby shower while Lerato thinks it's old-fashioned to invite women only.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: The love mat gets pulled out from under Sussie's feet and she suffers a double shock. Marius and Vicky's feelings for each other grow but is the time right and can it work again?

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: A few setbacks threaten to derail the baby shower. Carlo is still like clay in the hands of Valdez but Astrid suspects that Valdez isn't playing an open hand with her.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Vicky and Marius move to her mothers place. Sussie tries hard to assist the unemployed JP and presses unwilling Fran's buttons.

videos.title: Episode 83
videos.overview: Sussie gets an offer for King Pie. Carlo confronts Astrid about her knowledge of his investment. Wouter's life gets more and more direction.

videos.title: Episode 84
videos.overview: Meanwhile Marius and Petrus try to get a reluctant Anthony to join the gym. Wouter's still trying to figure out what's wrong with Nadine but nobody has the heart to tell him the truth.

videos.title: Episode 85
videos.overview: Stef gets new information about the trust money and Isabel makes another attempt at getting the stubborn Carlo to see the light show.

videos.title: Episode 86
videos.overview: Anthony reaps the benefits of his gym session and Marius has an unpleasant surprise for him. Lerato realizes that her grandmother has plans that don't include her - she's shocked when she finds out what they are.

videos.title: Episode 87
videos.overview: JP's plan to catch Astrid fails. Stef makes Isabel understand that he's not to scheme behind Carlo's back again. The new security rules at De Ruimtes cause frustration. Carlo ensures JP that his worries are a thing of the past. Isabel begins to doubt herself when she finds out about Carlo's good deeds.

videos.title: Episode 88
videos.overview: JP and Sussie's love blossoms while Wouter's down about Nadine. Stef gets shocking news. Things that are important to Carlo get pulled out from under his feet. Nadine's living a secretive life and lets no-one in.

videos.title: Episode 89
videos.overview: Carlo is devastated, but Isabel does her best to comfort him and encourages him to hang in. Anthony encourages Fran to get more exercise and Wouter has hope for the future once more. Astrid drops a bomb while Marius finds out more about the intruder at De Ruimtes. Meanwhile, Isabel still has doubts about Nadine ...

videos.title: Episode 90
videos.overview: The incident at De Ruimtes haunts Fritz and he is convinced that Astrid has something to do with it. JP's reluctant to post his interview with Astrid - he's caught between the devil and the deep blue sea. Sussie is nervous about JP's situation and takes out her frustration on everyone. Lerato decides to approach Casual Day seriously.

videos.title: Episode 91
videos.overview: Carlo says goodbye to Bloemfontein and Astrid isn't impressed when she hears who her partner is. Marius leaves for PE earlier and leaves behind a disappointed Sussie.

videos.title: Episode 92
videos.overview: Sussie is devastated by JP's departure but the birth of Louw birth brings comfort. Lerato realizes how small Petrus' heart is. Nadine gets the results of her drug test.

videos.title: Episode 93
videos.overview: Sussie decides to forget her own grief to focus on other people but it only helps to a small extent. There is great excitement at the Villa when the first pictures of Louw arrive.

videos.title: Episode 94
videos.overview: Wouter reaches out to Nadine again but a brutal shock awaits him. Fritz broods over Fran's blog and finally confesses to Marius about the true reasons for his reticence.

videos.title: Episode 95
videos.overview: Marius convinces Fritz to go with to PE - he can't wait to meet Fritzie, unaware of Stef's feelings. Astrid is clearly on a mission to destroy Isabel and Stef decides to extend more than a hand of friendship to Isabel.

videos.title: Episode 96
videos.overview: Fritz and Marius return from PE less fortunate than they'd hoped. Sussie's unhappy with Lerato but has food for thought. Lerato draws a line for Petrus and the two are it again! Anthony and Stef try to intervene to make Isabel's life easier. What's going on with Nadine and Astrid's latest evil plan?

videos.title: Episode 97
videos.overview: Fran makes Fritz aware that he's neglected Stef. Astrid realizes that Stef set her an e-mail trap. Lerato and Anthony make a formidable team and Petrus sheepishly retreats.

videos.title: Episode 98
videos.overview: Fritz and Fran work together on the blog but soon start bickering. Isabel's stress levels soar when she gets a call from the factory and Anthony walks by. Petrus gets the shock of his life - he's sure he's going to spend the rest of his life in prison. Astrid plays a dangerous new game that can shatter careers ...

videos.title: Episode 99
videos.overview: Sussie is excited to finally meet small Louw and Marius cannot wait to see his son again. Wouter refuses to believe that Nadine uses drugs while Anthony is determined to bring about peace between Fritz and Fran.

videos.title: Episode 100
videos.overview: Petrus is down and convinced about jail. He has no choice but to tell Marius. Marius admits to Sussie that he and Vicky had a nasty falling out. Carlo arrives unexpectedly and Isabel convinces him that she is in complete control, but then he hears something from Nadine who makes him wonder. Fran is not so sure she wants to write the blog with Fritz  ...

videos.title: Episode 101
videos.overview: It's National Braai Day and the atmosphere at the Villa is festive. Lerato takes the blog reins firmly and surprises Anthony. Petrus prepares for his jail days and enjoys his unexpected day off a little too much. Carlo and Astrid butt heads. Where is a very mysterious Sussie going?

videos.title: Episode 102
videos.overview: Stef progresses in her investigation to help Petrus. Anthony encourages Lerato not to give up with Nadine. When Fran tells Stef about his feelings for Isabel, he leaves nothing out. Fritz and Stef have a sincere conversation. Carlo is on a mission to destroy Astrid.

videos.title: Episode 103
videos.overview: Petrus is furious about the line Astrid has drawn for him, but she feels she has done nothing wrong. Nadine gets a call from someone from her past while Petrus builds further muscle - now for a different reason.

videos.title: Episode 104
videos.overview: The nets tightens round Astrid but, as usual, she has a wildcard up her sleeve. Isabel is at breaking point. Anthony supports her - but with ugly consequences. Wouter obsesses about something, but he does not speak about it and Petrus prepares for a strange new job for extra income.

videos.title: Episode 105
videos.overview: Marius wonders if his family's future is still in South Africa but Stef warns him that Vicky might not be so inclined with his plans. Isabel makes it very clear that Astrid is going to pay for her actions and Stef persuades Carlo to work closely with Astrid. Astrid messes with the youngsters' heads.

videos.title: Episode 106
videos.overview: Where has disappeared Nadine to and why can't she share her secret with anyone? Astrid gives Lerato an assignment ... but she is sincere or is it just another one of Astrid's scams?

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: It seems there's more behind the sabotage of Isabel's Fashion Week catastrophe. Marius becomes more pessimistic about the state of affairs in South Africa.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Fran gives all of her attention to her new novel and it's driving Fritz round the bend because the Web work has to be finished. The young people support Nadine. Carlo tightens the screws on Astrid but then something happens to him ... Astrid is ready and once again, blood flows.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Carlo is relieved that Isabel's pulled herself together and started focusing on her again while Wouter is afraid that Sussie will see the oil slick that he accidentally left on the patio.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Carlo hopes that this time he can go abroad without worrying about his mother and the project ... but the drama in Botshabelo is far from over. Astrid is very irritated by Stef's involvement in the project and tells Carlo something that takes the wind out of his sails.

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Astrid's seed flourishes and Carlo avoids Isabel. Has she won this round? Fritz and Fran's blog success is phenomenal and they have an important decision. Fran cannot resist a good fight and Lerato meets her new "opponent". What now Wouter? Sussie love for Louw might cost her dearly and Astrid convenes a meeting that she's looking very forward to ...

videos.title: Episode 112
videos.overview: Wouter is on a secret mission that makes Nadine worried and results in a hard grip of Fritz. There is peace between Isabel and Carlo but Astrid is ready with her ​​next plan with Carlo's business. Fran and Fritz work in peace but in between she asks him all sorts of personal questions ... for her next novel, of course ...

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Carlo is heading back to Italy and wondering how Isabel will handle them all. Astrid is angry at Lerato who refuses to dance to her tune while Stef gives Wouter a chance to confess about the stolen parts.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Wouter and Petrus make peace but not before Wouter lets Petrus sweat a little. Fritz and Fran challenge each other not to tell while lies but they do not realize how difficult it will be.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Lerato is hard at work, studying for the exams while Fritz and Fran's blog career reaches new heights. Petrus' first night at his new job arrives. A new face knocks at the Villa.

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Petrus' double-shifts at Bakgat and the club begin to take their toll: Nadine is supportive but Marius gives Peyrus an ultimatum. Walter and Nadine plan to play Cupid to Lerato and Mikey to bring them together but will it works? ...

videos.title: Episode 117
videos.overview: Wouter & Co. have good time at the nightclub where Petrus works but he and Nadine wonder why Mikey pulled out. Anthony blames Lerato and her friend, the hacker, for his computer problems while Sussie and Marius eventually get a chance to talk about their weekend in Port Elizabeth.

videos.title: Episode 118
videos.overview: Mikey books in at the Villa, but things don't go quite as he hoped when he eventually meets Lerato. Anthony is very discouraged about the adversity he's faced with his computer. Petrus' double life catches up with him and he can't keep his eyes open at Bakgat.

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Will Mikey win Lerato's heart? Petrus struggles to stay ahead despite the fact that he's been getting some rest. Nadine and Marius give him food for thought.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: Mikey has trouble in his pursuit of Lerato but Wouter talks courage into him. Isabel reaches out to Nadine but rubs her up the wrong way in the process, causing even more tension.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Isabel and Nadine have just reached a reconciliation and then Astrid starts manipulating poor Nadine. Fran puts Fritz in his place but regrets it and tries to gain his favour again.

videos.title: Episode 122
videos.overview: The girls are excited about Snotkop's presence, especially when he invites them to a concert. Wouter finds Nadine's admiration for the singer. Marius has a bright idea and Petrus is enthusiastic.

videos.title: Episode 123
videos.overview: Lerato and Nadine are on Cloud 9 to be seeing two concerts in a row. Nobody knows what is going on with Mikey. Fritz struggles with the blog's latest issue and Astrid really not bothered as she pretends she is?

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Lerato tries to find out why Wouter and Mikey are so mysterious. The responsibility to save Carlo's business is a heavy burden for Isabel. Fritz is furious that his credibility as a columnist is questioned.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Mikey's future looks bleak and when Lerato reaches out to help, things go wrong. Petrus isn't handling the double work and ends up in a dead end when Marius confronts him.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Mikey tries to say goodbye to Lerato, but it's very difficult. Movember has barely started and already the Villa's men are competing with each other.

videos.title: Episode 127
videos.overview: Wouter isn't sure if his moustache matches up to the other hairy mens but Nadine convinces him to persevere. Sussie is very upset about Fritz's blog and wonders how Marius will respond.

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Has Petrus learnt his lesson and can he save his friendship with Marius? Sussie needs to keep her wits about her while she tries to play mediator between Prof and Marius. Fran's book is finished, but she's not sure what to do.

videos.title: Episode 129
videos.overview: Vicky and Louw's return ensures great joy in the family. Anthony and Fritz finally agree that Stef needs to give Astrid legal assistance but, as usual with Astrid, nothing works out as others have planned.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Anthony has an idea to make Movember even more interesting, while Petrus and Marius make peace.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Fritz finds out that it's not so easy playing babysitter. Fran encourages Petrus to start writing but it's not as easy as he thought. Nadine discovers that Astrid lied to Isabel. Stef's anger boils over when he realizes what Astrid did.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Has Petrus found his calling? Wouter and Lerato have a lot to say but cannot help wondering ... Isabel gets advice from Nadine and Fran almost eats her hat when Fritz surprises her.

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: Astrid plays a double game but Fritz has the upper hand. Astrid upsets Stef. Petrus is enthusiastic about his story and Fritz becomes his consultant. Lerato confronts Nadine about Astrid and gives her something to think about. Vicky's emotions are escalating and Marius becomes more and more worried ...

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked by what Astrid and her lawyer are getting up to after hours. Nadine is determined to stand up to Astrid, while Petrus diligently continues writing his short story.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Vicky finds time for herself. Fritz and Fran discover that their blog readers are astute. Petrus appoints a producer for his film. Wouter longs for Nadine. Astrid is optimistic that the verdict will be in her favour.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: For a while it seems that Vicky has things under control, but she's clearly not herself. Astrid is destroyed after the court's verdict and plays on Fritz's feelings.

videos.title: Episode 137
videos.overview: Petrus plays wonderfully at being a director and has big plans for Melanie. Nadine experiences a strange day in the mall. Wouter's resentment towards Stef grows and almost gets out of hand.

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Fritz worries because it's clear that there's a big screw loose with Stef. Sussie reaches out to Vicky and she's finally a bit more open with Sussie - but the true reason for her strange behaviour remains a mystery.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: Nadine is protective of Isabel. Marius realizes that child rearing is not always nice and easy while Petrus gets further inspired to shoot his movie. Fritz tries in vain to make peace between Stef and Wouter. Anthony supports both Isabel and Astrid. Or is Astrid playing a game with him?

videos.title: Episode 140
videos.overview: Wouter doesn't beat around the bush when he confronts Stef. Astrid flirts with Anthony, but he doesn't fall for it. Vicky chases Sussie from the loft, Astrid makes a shocking confession to Stef.

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: Marius is angry and seeks advice from Stef. Petrus announces his plans and Astrid visits Nadine. Petrus puts the movie on hold temporarily but Lerato's enthusiasm is contagious.

videos.title: Episode 142
videos.overview: Astrid messes with Wouter's head. Then Wouter ends up in trouble and deeply disappoints his Oupa. Lerato warns Nadine not to trust Astrid but Nadine isn't bothered. It is obvious that Vicky isn't herself but Marius and Sussie have no more advice. Petrus cannot wait to watch his movie.

videos.title: Episode 143
videos.overview: Vicky shocks Marius and he has no other choice but to put his foot down. What will she think of his ultimatum? Petrus is still depressed about Melanie's opinion of their film.

videos.title: Episode 144
videos.overview: Marius and Anthony get surprising news about Manies Organies. Isabel and Fritz are concerned about Wouter and Nadine's relationship but Wouter is stubborn - him and Nadine take a radical decision.

videos.title: Episode 145
videos.overview: Astrid only hears about the Villa shareholders' meeting at the last minute and is immediately suspicious. Marius and Sussie struggle at times to support Vicky, but are doing their best to avoid conflict.

videos.title: Episode 146
videos.overview: Isabel and Nadine's relationship runs downhill, full steam. Marius is concerned that Vicky's therapy sessions aren't helping her. Petrus is worried about his future.

videos.title: Episode 147
videos.overview: The situation with Vicky gets more disturbing and then Fran hears something that convinces her that Sussie is too involved with the family. Nadine is too afraid to tell Isabel of her work with Astrid and Astrid gets Fritz subtly involved in the situation.

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: Wouter is still looking hard for a house for him and Nadine and almost gets trapped. Astrid puts pressure on Nadine to make a decision. Isabel is at her wits end and takes out her frustration on Fritz.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: Sussie is at breaking point: her heart is at the lofts but she may not visit. Nadine takes a radical decision that sees Astrid smiling from ear to ear while Isabel is destroyed ... but Stef is there to console Isabel. Vicky's emotions are still ride roller coastering and she withdraws more and more.

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Vicky refuses to go for further treatment and Marius and Sussie fear she may do something to Louw. Nadine doubts the future with Wouter while Lerato still tries to persuade Petrus to be Santa Claus.

videos.title: Episode 151
videos.overview: No matter how hard Marius tries, he has begun to crumble under the pressure of Vicky's situation. Nadine gets an unpleasant surprise in her workplace. Petrus tackles his Santa role fully.

videos.title: Episode 152
videos.overview: Marius and Sussie feel haggard without Louw but are hopeful that Vicky will get the necessary help at a clinic in PE. Isabel is uncertain how to act when she finds out that Nadine's staying at Backpackers. Fran warns Sussie that she's too involved with Marius, but Sussie refuses to admit it.

videos.title: Episode 153
videos.overview: It's Christmas Eve ... Lerato and Petrus are enthusiastic about their performance for the Abraham Kriel children. Even Nadine jumps in to help but Wouter isn't in the mood.

videos.title: Episode 154
videos.overview: It's Christmas Day and Fran has a special treat for the children of Abraham Kriel Children's Home. She is tense, because the person does not arrive ...

videos.title: Episode 155
videos.overview: Mari tells news that shocks Fritz. She makes a proposal to Fritz that they may have more control over Wouter and Nadine's relationship. Mari's presence in the Villa leaves Fran's eyebrows raised ... but what is the real reason?

videos.title: Episode 156
videos.overview: Wouter spends time with his new grandmother and Ruby and Nadine feel like spare wheels. Fritz is upset when Mari makes a decision without consulting him.

videos.title: Episode 157
videos.overview: Fritz is positive about the idea that he and Mari be together again. Anthony confronts Astrid about her money. Nadine is unhappy that Wouter may go to France. Fran is not in favour of the fact that Fritz and Mari are reunited.

videos.title: Episode 158
videos.overview: Mari leaves quietly - she leaves behind a dejected Fritz. Ruby's plan to make Fritz jealous of Ian doesn't work and she hides in her room while everyone else sees in the New Year.

videos.title: Episode 159
videos.overview: Lerato tries to find out the reason for Petrus' sombre mood. Astrid has a surprise for Nadine but why is Wouter more excited about it? Sussie is extremely happy and Marius is wary around her.

videos.title: Episode 160
videos.overview: Wouter and Nadine are excited about their new home but Astrid has a manipulative plan in her sleeve ... and maybe Isabel does to.  Lerato lobbies to get Marius and Sussie together but will her plans work out?

videos.title: Episode 161
videos.overview: Wouter annoys everyone with his flute but then Lerato has an idea that could help him. Fritz discovers that Astrid is playing havoc with Vicky over her apartment and decides to address the matter. Nadine is weepy and no-one knows why.

videos.title: Episode 162
videos.overview: Isabel is only too happy when Nadine returns to the loft. Fritz encourages Wouter to nurture his relationship with Nadine. Petrus's "disappearance" shocks his friends, especially Lerato who handles it badly.

videos.title: Episode 163
videos.overview: Anthony confronts Astrid about strange information that he's found out. Lerato focuses on Petrus's disappearance and Ruby makes an announcement that catches Fritz off guard.

videos.title: Episode 164
videos.overview: Vicky is back and makes it very clear that she doesn't need Sussie's help raising her child. The discomfort between Marius and Sussie continues while things between Wouter and Nadine are also not on track. Anthony confronts Astrid about irregularities in her business.

videos.title: Episode 165
videos.overview: Wouter finds a mentor in Stef regarding his relationship with Nadine. Vicky's first day back at work is more challenging than she thought. An innocent Sussie finds herself at the wrong time and place. Fran gives her valuable advice. Vicky and Marius can't agree about Louw.

videos.title: Episode 166
videos.overview: The Marius, Sussie and Vicky triangle takes a strange twist. Sussie gets the shock of her life. Anthony worries himself terribly about Lerato's grief over Petrus's sudden departure. When he speaks to her about it she puts him in his place quickly.

videos.title: Episode 167
videos.overview: Isabel invites Stef and Wouter for dinner while Fran surprises everyone with her ​​latest fad. Vicky has a serious conversation with Sussie who is determined to get back to focusing on her work in the Villa.

videos.title: Episode 168
videos.overview: Stef's surrogate proposal doesn't deliver positive results with Isabel. Sussie grieves in silence over Louw. Fritz wants to talk to Vicky about Sussie but doesn't get the opportunity.

videos.title: Episode 169
videos.overview: Nadine blames Isabel for interfering in her life. Stef is still wrestling with the idea of ​​having children and Astrid leads Nadine from the frying pan into the fire.

videos.title: Episode 170
videos.overview: Nadine is extremely upset about the previous night's events. Lerato is tired of her father's attitude and makes it very clear that she will search for Petrus with or without his consent. Marius needs to look after Louw for the day and realizes that it isn't so easy. Sussie brings good news for Lerato.

videos.title: Episode 171
videos.overview: Astrid continues scheming to crash Isabel and Nadine's relationship. Wouter and Nadine's boat sails in troubled waters and a new girl in town doesn't make it any easier.

videos.title: Episode 172
videos.overview: Lerato could burst with excitement and the Villa Rosers wonder if it's something with the new gas deal. Wouter and Nadine find solace and advice from various quarters as they lick their wounds.

videos.title: Episode 173
videos.overview: Isabel tries to comfort a sad Nadine while Wouter asks Sussie for advice. The attractive Jacques impresses everyone in the Villa - especially Lerato - too much for Anthony's liking.

videos.title: Episode 174
videos.overview: Anthony finds himself in unfamiliar territory with Lerato who's head over heels in love. Astrid lets Santie know that her services to lead Wouter astray are over.

videos.title: Episode 175
videos.overview: Jacques pulls out all the stops to impress Lerato but his charms don't impress Anthony. Fran gives Lerato advice. Sussie has good news for Vicky, but Vicky is still not comfortable with Sussie in the vicinity.

videos.title: Episode 176
videos.overview: Anthony is very worried about his daughter but Fran and Sussie tell him to give her space. Nadine discovers something in Astrid's office that isn't meant for her eyes.

videos.title: Episode 177
videos.overview: Lerato's heart is torn apart after Jacques' betrayal. She broods, plans something and then drops a bomb that shatters the Villa.

videos.title: Episode 178
videos.overview: Sussie watches over Louw in the days but Vicky is not happy with the situation. Things at the Villa deteriorate because Sussie isn't there to do everything smoothly.

videos.title: Episode 179
videos.overview: Sussie is in her element as Louw's keeper but not everyone shares her enthusiasm. Then Vicky also gets an e-mail from the Cape that threatens Fritz's world. Anthony gets a mysterious call and Nadine approaches him for help. Astrid tries to outsmart Nadine and Isabel gets a surprise ...

videos.title: Episode 180
videos.overview: It's very difficult for Vicky to say goodbye to Louw when she goes to Cape Town but Sussie promises that she'll look after him like gold. Isabel is slightly skeptical of Liam but she gets to know him better and develops more appreciation for him.

videos.title: Episode 181
videos.overview: Sussie's work as an au pair causes her to get isolated and the loneliness begins to gnaw at her. Astrid gives Stef information that could help him with his complicated case.

videos.title: Episode 182
videos.overview: Fran is worked up about the upcoming function and Fritz tries to calm her. Nadine tries to get information against Astrid but Astrid is too smart for her.

videos.title: Episode 183
videos.overview: Fritz's admiration for Zanne causes him to act clumsily. Nadine gives Anthony information that she got on Astrid's laptop got and he discovers something suspicious.

videos.title: Episode 184
videos.overview: The inimitable and talented Zanne Stapelberg has crept deep into Fritz's heart he finds it very difficult to say goodbye to her. Wouter tries to make up with Nadine but traps himself in even deeper trouble. Liam's power over Carlo gets stronger and stronger with far-reaching consequences ...

videos.title: Episode 185
videos.overview: Nadine is upset after her dinner date with the children's home donor but Liam comforts and supports her. Sussie is full of praise for Vicky ... until Vicky does something.

videos.title: Episode 186
videos.overview: Isabel is very worried about Carlo's mood but Liam convinces her that he will talk with Carlo. Anthony asks Stef to negotiate with Astrid on his behalf and Astrid lets them sweat for a while.

videos.title: Episode 187
videos.overview: Liam finally shows his true colors and starts making demands of Astrid. He also convinces Carlo to go away with his mother for a few days. Eben thinks of a plan to make money with Wouter and plays on Carina's feelings.

videos.title: Episode 188
videos.overview: Fran is determined to put the sparkle back into Sussie but soon realizes that it's hard work. Liam plays a fine game between unsuspecting Astrid and Nadine.

videos.title: Episode 189
videos.overview: Celeste-Elize Rautenbach, nose in the air mother of Eben and Carina, arrives and her presence causes immediate consternation from Bakgat to the Villa.

videos.title: Episode 190
videos.overview: Carina and Eben's mother does further research to see if the Villa is good enough for her children. Nadine has had enough of Astrid's bad treatment and eventually stands up for herself.

videos.title: Episode 191
videos.overview: Carina and Eben are embarrassed about their mother's bragging. Liam suggests that he and Carlo prepare a meal for Isabel but, naturally, he has other plans.

videos.title: Episode 192
videos.overview: Things at The Space are very uncomfortable and dangerous. Vicky and Marius aren't on the same page. Sussie and Celeste are like oil and water. Or is it fat and fire?

videos.title: Episode 193
videos.overview: Carlo confronts Liam about the suspicious bottle. Anthony decides that Isabel must have blood tests taken. Eben has big plans for his and Wouter's tentative business.

videos.title: Episode 194
videos.overview: Wouter gathers his courage and talks to Fritz about his business plan. Fritz is positive but wonders what lies behind everything. Stef warns Astrid about her finances and is uneasy.

videos.title: Episode 195
videos.overview: Astrid opens her heart to Stef but he doesn't want to know her. Nadine says goodbye to her Bloemfontein friends with great difficulty, while Vicky reaches out a hand of friendship to Sussie.

videos.title: Episode 196
videos.overview: The Villa learns with shock what happened with Isabel and Carlo. Stef blames Anthony when he admits that he knew there were problems. Astrid tries, in vain, to find out what's going on.

videos.title: Episode 197

Carina still hides the truth about their father's new relationship from Eben while Vicky gives Stef advice on how to deal with Nico. Maryke manipulates Anthony to get more money out of him.

videos.title: Episode 192
videos.overview: Anthony stands on a cliff edge with Maryke and does not realize it. Saskia immediately puts her mark on the villa and begins to show her true colors when Gunther involves her into his plans. Sonja starts to wonder about Nico. Isabel is about to leava and a heavy farewell lies ahead.

Maryke is bitter because she cannot attend Isabel's farewell and she argues with Nico. Gunther is relieved when Saskia is positive about the research but she warns him that they will have to be careful. Carina is surprised by Eben's news as he returns from the farm.

videos.title: Episode 194
videos.overview: Maryke continues exploiting Anthony's generosity... Nico goes along with things but how long will he be content to see her in another man's arms? Stef is determined to unmask Nico and calls in Vicky's help. Will they be able to continue hiding things from everyone while Stef seeks the truth? Carina surprises Marius and Saskia makes sure Gunther knows what her rules are.

videos.overview: Sarah catches Nico digging around the Villa. Fritz and Maryke have a frank conversation. Saskia lays down the rules for her and Gunther's friendship and their project. Eben gets news about AJ. Anthony is determined to get out of the Villa. Maryke and Nico's machinations are rampant but their relationship begins cracking. Anthony is blinded by love for Maryke.

videos.title: Episode 196
videos.overview: Stef returns from the Cape with interesting news, but he only shares it with Vicky. Carina is worried about Eben again but Marius reassures her. Gunther finds out about Astrid's history with the diamond smuggler Valdez and immediately investigates further. Meanwhile, Maryke gets Anthony's offer to purchase the house and gives it to Nico to doctor...

videos.title: Episode 197
videos.overview: Maryke and Nico rig new plans regarding Anthony. Sonja fills Stef in about what she knows about Nico and he follows it up with a surprising proposal to Gunther. Marius asks Carina out officially but then things go wrong.

videos.title: Episode 198
videos.overview: Stef's plan to unmask Nico goes well but then things go wrong. Fritz tries in vain to explain to Anthony why he is worried about his and Maryke's relationship and an unexpected house guest arrives which further complicates Anthony's life. Eben's new friend pops into Bakgat and doesn't make a good impression on Carina.

videos.title: Episode 199
videos.overview: To Maryke's frustration, Fran plays the supportive future mother in law while watching Maryke like a hawk. Stef hits a blank when he wants to give Anthony insights and Marius surprises Carina and himself when he talks to her about Eben. Cardo executes a dubious transaction under Eben's nose. Maryke finds herself in a predicament. Will she be able to worm out of it?

videos.title: Episode 200
videos.overview: Fran is on a mission to catch out Maryke and she gets Stef's help. Cardo works cunningly. Nico wants to get out of Bloemfontein. Saskia realizes it will be difficult to mine diamonds at the Villa but Gunther won't let it stop him. Sonja hears wedding bells for Vicky and Stef. Anthony gets the shock of his life.

videos.title: Episode 201
videos.overview: Anthony tries to make sense of what happened to him but it's a bitter pill to swallow. Maryke worries that he might have smelled a rat and is extra gentle and loving. Sonja tries to bring Vicky and Stef together while Cardo decides to leave the Backpackers. Gunther is vague about the mineral rights and then Saskia finds out that he acted without her knowledge...

videos.title: Episode 202
videos.overview: Gunther makes a business decision but Saskia's sobering thoughts lead him to an unpleasant surprise. Eben waits for Cardo and Carina warns him in a sisterly manner. Maryke's betrayal pushes Anthony further into a corner and his future looks even more obscure suddenly when he gets an unexpected phone call.

videos.title: Episode 203
videos.overview: Everyone is shocked by a newspaper report that's clearly been planted by a vengeful Maryke. Marius warns Gunther to leave Carina alone. The men are in an uproar when Nico is seen in the mall. Stef suspects Maryke is far from done with Anthony and Saskia and Gunther's partnership is on shaky legs.

videos.title: Episode 204
videos.overview: Eben makes Cardo an offer he cannot refuse. Gunther gets put in place twice in one day and Fritz tries to give Stef and Vicky's love life a boost.

videos.title: Episode 205
videos.overview: Stef and Vicky are about to resume their relationship. Cardo's hero status buys him a stay at Villa Rosa. Maryke has knowledge of Stef's real brother but Stef is not interested. Two beloved characters say goodbye to Bloemfontein. It seems that Eben's involvement with Cardo will not work out for him. The Von West singing duo books in at the Villa.

videos.title: Episode 206
videos.overview: Eben does not feel well after the party he was at with Cardo and wonders if their drinks were laced. Vicky wants to ask Stef to get engaged but he has other plans. Meanwhile Sonja makes final arrangements to surprise the couple at Bakgat. An old friend of the Villa arrives - but isn't alone as always. This time he brings along a special friend...

videos.title: Episode 207
videos.overview: Love runs high for Stef and Vicky but it is hampered when Captain le Roux calls him and Maryke confronts him with a strange piece of evidence. Gunther and Saskia's plans are on track until Gunther receives an SMS which drives him over the edge. Uncle Gerhard and Kotie make themselves at home in the Villa.

videos.title: Episode 208
videos.overview: Eben is concerned about Cardo and then a bruised Cardo arrives at the Villa. Gunther warns Saskia about her close relationship with Fritz and he does not like her reaction. Gerhard is nervous about his visit to the doctor and is disappointed when Kotie tells everyone that they are just friends. Stef does not trust the peace between Saskia and Gunther.

videos.title: Episode 209
videos.overview: Saskia struggles to tame Gunther and has to do drastic damage control when he loses his head. Stef and Vicky invite Gerhard and Kotie over for dinner but Kotie doesn't enjoy the evening at all. Eben does secret research on drugs and becomes increasingly suspicious of Cardo. In the meantime, everyone forgets about Gekkedag...

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Fritz is very upset about Gunther's behaviour and is even more upset after Gunther makes all kinds of weird comments. Eben continues to spy on Cardo and Cardo catches him while he's in the workroom sniffing around. Gunther and Saskia get the results of the laboratory but it's not the news he wanted. Vicky is upset when Stef proposes a quick wedding.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Kotie 's hostility disappears when Vicky is nice to her. Eben takes pictures of Cardo while he is engaged in an illegal transaction. Kotie makes peace with Gerhard. Fritz doesn't want Gunter's Villa shares to fall into the hands of outsiders. Cardo suspects Eben knows about his drug offenses.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Saskia manipulates Fritz into possibly acquiring shares. Eben is uneasy about Cardo 's underhanded dealings but doesn't know how to tackle the problem. Gunther goes too far with Carina and Saskia gives him a final ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Gunther finds himself in a warm world and Saskia is the only one willing to refresh him with a drop of water. But at what price? Eben confronts Cardo with his evidence. Will Gerhard eventually succeed with Kotie? Marius tries to protect Carina but she decides to settle things in her own way .

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: Gunther feels he no longer serves a purpose in Bloemfontein and Saskia make sure Fritz is finally on her side . Gerhard seeks counsel with his love affairs after Kotie deeply hurts his honour. Stef and Marius still make plans to buy Gunther's Villa shares and Carina makes a proposal. A new guest at the villa but she's not the only one...

videos.title: Episode 6
videos.overview: Celine adapts to the Villa easily and Fritz, reluctantly, asks her to help. Marius and Stef do not like the idea that Saskia wants to buy Gunther's shares but she's clearly not someone who takes no for an answer. Gunther takes his farewell from Bloemfontein. Eben finds out that Celine and Cardo know each other and does not trust the peace at all.

videos.title: Episode 7
videos.overview: Gunther leaves Bloemfontein and it's not on Saskia 's agenda to grieve about it. Celine finds out Cardo is getting involved with drugs. Gerhard has back pain and Kotie is not exactly sympathetic. Vicky is radiantly happy and she doesn't hide it. Saskia receives a " house guest " who can drive her future plans.

videos.title: Episode 8
videos.overview: Liam 's sights are set on the Villa - with profound and shocking consequences. Kotie clucks to Gerhard. Celine and Carina get the feeling they are being watched and followed but Cardo shoots down their suspicions. A romantic morning between Vicky and Stef is soured when Stef answers Vicky 's phone.

videos.title: Episode 9
videos.overview: The Villa is in an uproar over Liam 's sudden appearance and Saskia behaves strangely when she hears about Louw 's kidnapping. Eben takes Fritz into his confidence about his suspicions regarding Kotie and doesn't get the response he had hoped for. Saskia returns from the hospital with news about Liam 's condition. Cardo tells Celine about the depth of the trouble he's in.

videos.title: Episode 10
videos.overview: Marius is frustrated with Carina who still wants to help Liam while Fritz tries to keep the peace between them. Cardo and Celine wonder what Cubby is planning. Stef gives Fritz advice on the appointment of the new housekeeper and Lida bumps head with Fritz.

videos.title: Episode 11
videos.overview: Carina focuses on Liam's rehabilitation so much that she neglects Marius. Gerhard deals with everyone's attitude towards Kotie while the Villa's new manager is concerned about the gossip. Saskia continues trying to convince Liam to leave Bloemfontein and Cardo plays a dangerous game. Someone rings the doorbell late at night and Celine is shocked when she opens the front door...

videos.title: Episode 12
videos.overview: Stef tries to reassure Vicky but she is in a state about Liam 's presence in Bloemfontein. Celine encourages Cardo to come to an agreement with Chubby and is concerned about the Villa Rosers' safety. Gerhard and Kotie 's new happiness is short-lived when Kotie answers a call that was actually for Gerhard. Carina's involvement with Liam causes tension between her and Marius.

videos.title: Episode 13
videos.overview: Everyone tries to convince Vicky that Liam is harmless but Vicky refuses to believe it. Marius feels threatened by the attention Carina gives to Liam. A relationship begins to form between Celine and Lida. Vicky loses control when she sees Liam. Celine becomes worried when she doesn't hear anything from Cardo. Vicky calls for an interdict against Liam.

videos.title: Episode 14
videos.overview: Gerhard and Kotie 's relationship reaches new highs and lows - and finally a turning point. Fritz discovers something that makes him very suspicious and Cardo gets good news for the first time in a long while. Celine is not so sure that it's good news. Saskia finally finds out what Liam 's actual intention is and she does not like it.

videos.title: Episode 15
videos.overview: Liam manipulates Carina and she feels sorry for him. Eben speaks to Cardo about his lifestyle and Celine happens to hear it. Vicky shocks Marius when she shares her plans for the honeymoon with him.

videos.title: Episode 16
videos.overview: Marius and Stef support a dejected Carina in getting to the truth behind Liam. Lida arrives late and considers moving in to the Villa. Celine makes peace with Eben. Marius is outraged at Louw and Stef suspects that Vicky lied about Liam's assault. Cardo runs into danger.

videos.title: Episode 17
videos.overview: Gang leader Chubby says he has big plans for Cardo - but what does he mean exactly? Marius and Vicky realize that they musn't let Liam impact on their lives and Vicky feels guilty about the interdict she got against him. Meanwhile, Liam warns Saskia to treat him with more respect. Lida surprises Fritz when she flatly refuses to work at night.

videos.title: Episode 18
videos.overview: Carina has become increasingly worried about her relationship with Liam and wonders if he has feelings for her. Eben is jealous of Cardo's relationship with Fritz. Lida arrives late and Fritz makes his voice heard, but a late night conversation with Lida takes the wind out of his sails. Saskia finds a measure of comfort in Vicky.

videos.title: Episode 19
videos.overview: Lida moves into the Villa and has her first quarrel with Fritz. Marius can no longer hide his hate for Liam. Stef persuades Vicky to have a child with him but it's not a part of Vicky 's future plans.

videos.title: Episode 20
videos.overview: Lida is too proud to discuss her personal life with Fritz. The net tightens round Cardo and Eben reaches out to help his friend. Carina sets Liam an ultimatum.

videos.title: Episode 21
videos.overview: Everyone prepares themselves for the meeting with Liam. Stef keeps Vicky positive - with difficulty. Cardo feels like a fly in Chubby 's web and tries fiercely to make a plan to get himself and Celine out.

videos.title: Episode 22
videos.overview: Liam 's memory is back. Everyone fears that he will sue the Villa. Carina is angry with Marius. Chubby threatens information from Worcester. Celine reminds Cardo how dangerous gansters are. Stef mocks Vicky over a threesome. Lida tells Fritz where her husband is. Cardo stands up against Chubby.

videos.title: Episode 23
videos.overview: Liam thinks he has the Villa Rosers in the palm of his hand but then Fritz surprises him. Marius is frustrated because he sees his son too little for his liking. Cardo decides not to sell drugs but Celine warns him that it could cost his life.

videos.title: Episode 24
videos.overview: Liam is trying to implement his plans and Saskia warns him to leave Vicky. Cardo gets three job interviews and Celine picks him out because he is indecisive about his future.

videos.title: Episode 25
videos.overview: Lida goes through deep sadness but the Villa's people keep her strong. Cardo and Celine struggle to talk about their true feelings for each other. Liam arrives at the Villa with an injured Vicky.

videos.title: Episode 26
videos.overview: Fritz gives Liam the boot at the Villa - but then he comes with a dangerous threat. Celine does not know how to handle her newfound love and Carina gives advice. Lida wrestles with moral decisions and Fritz supports her.

videos.title: Episode 27
videos.overview: Fritz waves the white flag but Liam is not interested in peace. The discord spreads to the lofts where Vicky and Stef are in a dilemma over the interdict.

videos.title: Episode 28
videos.overview: Eben involves Carina with his plans to arrange a surprise for Celine and Cardo. Lida must prepare for the evening's visit but devastating nightmares hamper her focus. Fritz is there for her with wisdom and advice.

videos.title: Episode 29
videos.overview: Cardo and Celine are madly in love and Eben cannot help but feel disappointed. Lida gets upsetting news that she hides from all - except Fritz. Meanwhile, Liam is determined to find out what Saskia is actually looking for in Bloemfontein, while Cardo gets the shock of his life.

videos.title: Episode 30
videos.overview: Liam realizes he has the upper hand over Saskia and makes sure she knows it. Celine cannot understand Cardo's surly attitude and tries to get information from Eben but is forced to confront Cardo himself. Lida experiences the hardest day of her life and Fritz tries his best to support her. Liam gives Stef an interesting piece of news about Saskia's business.

videos.title: Episode 31
videos.overview: Lida struggles to cope with her husband's death. Chubby visits the Villa and soon discovers he is not welcome. Saskia would like to tell someone that Liam makes her life difficult but she realizes it is information that she should keep to herself.

videos.title: Episode 32
videos.overview: Fritz appeals to the Villa Rosers to assist Lida during her grieving process. Eben and Carina agree. Liam puts pressure on Saskia who worries about purchasing Gunther's shares until Stef provides the perfect solution. Celine wants to support Cardo when he meets Chubby but it ends badly for the young lovers ...

videos.title: Episode 33
videos.overview: Cardo is in a corner and Celine takes a decision that puts their future at risk. Lida emotionally opens-up to Fritz and Celine - Fritz surprises her with something special. Liam puts pressure on Saskia and she doesn’t know how to escape from his clutches.

videos.title: Episode 34
videos.overview: Cardo and Celine suffer after their relationship comes an end. They both find support from the Villa 's people. Lida seeks comfort in the work room. Liam makes a revelation that makes Saskia think she has the upper hand - until Liam comes up with a dark secret that will change Saskia’s life irrevocably.

videos.title: Episode 35
videos.overview: Saskia looks for evidence that her sister is still alive and Liam quickly makes a cunning plan. Chubby tries to get Celine on his side and Eben invites her out for the night. Lida tells Fritz what she got up to in the work room, while Stef surprises Vicky with his plans for their honeymoon.

videos.title: Episode 36
videos.overview: Eben and Celine put up with the consequences of a pleasant night out and Carina wonders if Eben may have feelings for Celine. Lida struggles to say goodbye to Dietmar and the Villa's people are worried about her.

videos.title: Episode 37
videos.overview: Lida is nervous about Dietmar's funeral. Celine receives a gift from Chubby but this time she confronts him. Vicky invites Saskia to the wedding. Liam manipulates the situation with Saskia so that Fritz has to ask for help. Liam makes it clear that Monique's life depends on working in co-operation with Saskia.

videos.title: Episode 38
videos.overview: Celine and Cardo's friendship rests on the sharp edge of a blade and Chubby, aware of this, uses it to his advantage. Eben is a sounding board for Cardo and Celine. Fritz pulls no punches when spells out the conditions of Liam's stay at the Villa. Lida 's fickleness impacts on Fritz .

videos.title: Episode 39
videos.overview: Liam 's game with Villa Rosers becomes more dangerous and Saskia does not know how to put a stop to it. Everyone wants to know what had happened to Cardo's finger - but he conceals the truth.

videos.title: Episode 40
videos.overview: Vicky is stressed with regard to her finances and takes out her frustrations on Stef who also experiencesunexpected adversity. Cardo sees something that convinces him that there is a romance brewing between Eben and Celine and Eben is very concerned about Cardo's emotional state.

videos.title: Episode 41
videos.overview: Cardo is deeply hurt by Celine and Eben's betrayal. Stef gets a shock when property is being bought with his stolen credit card. Eben has a plan to get rid of Chubby.

videos.title: Episode 42
videos.overview: Vicky is troubled when she finds out that Liam lives in Saskia 's loft but Fritz reassures her - not knowing Liam already has him in his pocket. Chubby worms his way into the Villa and puts more and more pressure on Cardo.

videos.title: Episode 43
videos.overview: Cardo is still split in two and Fritz tries to support him as well as he can. Will he stay or will he disappear from their lives? Vicky gets an unexpected visitor from PE who acts very strangely at times. Carina and Eben forget they also have a guest whose appearance created a stir between brother and sister. Liam 's sinister little plans run smoothly.

videos.title: Episode 44
videos.overview:
Vicky 's drama knows no bounds. The icing on the cake is when Stef suspects Liam of everything. Eben confronts Cardo and again offers his help. Ilse works with Eben at Bakgat.

Celine 's desperate attempt to keep Cardo at the Villa has failed. Chubby is impressed with Cardo 's decision. Jenny opens up her heart to Vicky.

videos.title: Episode 45
videos.overview: Vicky and Stef disagree about Liam. Vicky asks Marius for advice. Carina gives Ilse a make-over. Cardo greets the Villa Rosers but Celine struggles to accept his departure. Cardo makes a very important choice. Vicky gets shocking news.

videos.title: Episode 46
videos.overview: Vicky tells Marius the shocking news but it's clear that she is totally in denial. Not even Stef can get through to her. Ilse hears something she should not have heard and Liam must think quickly to cover his tracks.

videos.title: Episode 47
videos.overview: Fritz oversleeps and the supposedly sympathetic Liam is glad to see that he's not himself. Cardo visits his father in prison and Chubby tries to manipulate him again while Lida asks Carina to be friendlier with Ilse. Meanwhile Stef and Marius realise that Vicki's denying the truth and they try in vain to get through to her

videos.title: Episode 48
videos.overview: Fritz is devastated but Liam acts as his saviour and confidante. Marius and Vicky have mixed feelings about the situation with Louw. Although Chubby is in jail, Cardo is uneasy about his and Celine's safety.

videos.title: Episode 49
videos.overview: Fritz 's behaviour begins to worry the other Villa Rosers more by the day. Vicky and Marius's crisis begins to take its toll and Stef and Carina must keep it together. Liam comes up with a very dirty plan which further unnerves Fritz. Eben is completely caught off guard by a very innocent note and Marius goes too far. .

videos.title: Episode 50
videos.overview: Stef, Marius and Vicky fight hard to trust each other after Jenny drops the bomb about Louw. Marius starts to doubt his own actions. Stef also has his hands full with Fritz - whose strange behaviour and forgetfulness becomes all the more alarming to the Villa people.

videos.title: Episode 51
videos.overview: Vicky gets upsetting news and her world collapses once again. Fritz realizes something is seriously wrong with him and Liam makes sure he is the only one who trusts the professor.

videos.title: Episode 52
videos.overview: Fritz feels worse than ever and cannot recall that he went out for lunch with Liam or that he promised to do business with Liam. Stef confronts Liam about his father but Liam convinces Stef that he has Fritz’s best interests at heart.

videos.title: Episode 53
videos.overview: Saskia returns and Liam starts to play a dangerous game, one which she doesn’t want to take part in but cannot escape. Lida reaches out to Hanna, only for things to turn for the worst. Marius and Vicky have reached breaking point, and to top it all, Marius’ DNA results are imminent.

videos.title: Episode 54
videos.overview: Lida asks Eben that the Villa Rosers try to keep an open mind where Hanna is concerned when he confronts her about her daughter’s behaviour. In the meantime Hanna is on her own mission and Carina and even Liam get a taste of her wrath.

videos.title: Episode 55
videos.overview: Liam and Saskia call a truce, but not before Liam manages to get exactly what he wanted all along from Fritz. Hanna tries to stamp her authority on Eben, but Carina is having none of it. Now that Marius is aware of Louw’s DNA results, he vanishes without a trace, leaving Carina terrified of what the future might bring.

videos.title: Episode 56
videos.overview: Liam continues with his mean tricks and intensifies his efforts until he gets caught and accused in Fritz’s presence. But will Fritz see the truth?  Saskia and Liam butt heads and she starts putting her own plan in motion to thwart Liam.

videos.title: Episode 57
videos.overview: Saskia reaches out to Vicky, while Eben tries to cheer Celine up. Lida and Hanna are at loggerheads again and Hanna flings one reproach after the other at her mother. Stef finds out that Fritz is standing surety for Liam’s new business and this leads to a nasty falling-out. Stef threatens to take drastic steps and Fritz is seething with rage.

videos.title: Episode 58
videos.overview: Vicky admits to Jenny that she knows that Louw is not her child. Eben attempts to cheer up Celine but realises it is not going to be easy. Marius is suspicious of Jenny’s motives. Stef wants Fritz’s signature to make decisions on behalf of Fritz. Lida asks Eben to employ Hanna temporary at Bakgat. Marius starts to crack under emotional pressure.

videos.title: Episode 59
videos.overview: Carina tries to convince Vicky to take Louw to Marius. Jenny makes a decision for Vicky. Vicky ignores Stef, but surprises Marius. Saskia tries to take Fritz to the doctor. Liam creates chaos in the garden. Hanna continues to be rude, but Fritz has had enough. Liam keeps on winning Fritz’s trust and sits on his next scheme.

videos.title: Episode 60
videos.overview: Vicky and Marius struggle with the reality of Louw not being their child, and Stef feels more and more like an outsider. When Fritz discovers Liam ruined his rose garden he is furious, but Liam places the blame on Lida.

videos.title: Episode 61
videos.overview: Stef tries to reach out to Vicky but Vicky is an emotional mess. Stef admits to Liam that Fritz has no choice but to stay involved in Liam’s new business but when Stef discovers someone broke into his office he gives Liam a stern warning.

videos.title: Episode 62
videos.overview: There are mixed emotions surrounding Jenny’s arrival in Bloem, but are her intentions as honourable as Vicky thinks? Hanna’s financial conundrum forces her to consider options she’s never had to during the sheltered years before her father’s accident.

videos.title: Episode 63
videos.overview: Vicky and Stef are still like ships passing in the night, but she finds comfort in Jenny’s presence. Celine is tense about Cardo’s return, while Hanna surprises Lida with her change of attitude.

videos.title: Episode 64
videos.overview: The situation at Stef’s work gets even worse and he is close to breaking point. Saskia does not trust Jenny’s true motives but Vicky continues to uphold the illusion of friendship between her and Jenny.

videos.title: Episode 65
videos.overview: Vicky and Stef try to keep their relationship up, but not without struggle. Cardo is not pleased with a gift he receives from Celine. Saskia doesn’t trust Jenny. Stef knows Liam is responsible for the fiasco at Van Romburg and Retief, but he has no proof.

videos.title: Episode 66
videos.overview: Liam takes one destructive further step to destroy Stef and the Villa. Celine confronts a distanced Cardo, and his explanation as to why, leaves her shocked. Stef and Vicky have reached a point of no return, and neither of them know how to make things right.

videos.title: Episode 67
videos.overview: Liam promises to solve the Villa’s problems but when the health inspector knocks on the door he helps Fritz into the abyss with a smile. His diabolical plan threatens the Villa’s survival. Will Fritz ever realise just how close he’s keeping his enemy?

videos.title: Episode 68
videos.overview: Vicky tries to not make enemies with Jenny. Jenny promises there are no hard feelings, but Vicky is not convinced. Saskia is there as a friend for Stef. She also gives Stef enough information about Liam to send him on a path to take care of Liam once and for all.

videos.title: Episode 69
videos.overview: Fritz tells Vicky about Jenny’s remark regarding Louw, making Vicky and the men in her life agonise even more. Eben is worried about Celine and tries to find out whether Wouter has any real feelings for her. Saskia sees through Liam’s empty threats and encourages Stef to take him on.

videos.title: Episode 70
videos.overview: Vicky is positive again and Stef supports her. Cardo wants Celine back, but she is not so sure. Jenny considers going back to Port Elizabeth.

videos.title: Episode 71
videos.overview: Beulah haunts Wouter and it seems he won’t be able to escape, but then she also makes a revelation about who she really is. Jenny invites Vicky for lunch and the event turns horribly nasty. Celine makes a naïve remark to Eben and he has to face an uncomfortable probability.

videos.title: Episode 72
videos.overview: Everyone except Vicky is ready for battle, but Jenny has seemingly disappeared. Is Vicky right about her? Is Jenny satisfied with knowing she’s Louw’s mother? Wouter pulls out all the stops when wooing Celine, much to Cardo’s frustration.

videos.title: Episode 73
videos.overview: The Villa finds itself in a crossfire when a report is written that puts the Villa in a bad light. Stef has no other option but to quit his job, but that is the least of his problems. Beulah refuses to accept that her romance with Wouter is a thing of the past. Marius and Vicky’s worst fear turns into reality.

videos.title: Episode 74
videos.overview: Vicky is back to hiding in her bubble. She confronts Jenny about the real reason behind the summons. Jenny shares a shocking truth. Fritz struggles to accept all the bad news, but he keeps on supporting everyone. Liam learns the truth about Hanna’s workings behind the scenes.

videos.title: Episode 75
videos.overview: Lida feels Fritz shouldn’t judge Jenny, while Marius is worried about his son after what happened the night before. Beulah is going flat-out for Cardo and Wouter tries in vain to curry favour with her.

videos.title: Episode 76
videos.overview: Hanna prods Liam to open up emotionally about his past, only to be shocked by his revelations. Marius and Vicky have a hard time downplaying their imminent flight, but then something unforseen happens.

videos.title: Episode 77
videos.overview: Fritz is deeply upset with Vicky and Marius. He warns them of the consequences of their actions but secretly wonders if he gave them the right advice.

videos.title: Episode 78
videos.overview: Emotions run high when the day arrives for Louw to go to his biological mother: Jenny. Lida supports Fritz who has trouble letting go as he is afraid Louw will forget him. Wouter forgets about his "silly" personal problems to be there for his family.

videos.title: Episode 79
videos.overview: Vicky is a broken woman and has very upsetting news for Stef who still confides in Saskia. Beulah tries her best to convince Cardo that he is the man for her but will promise her love to another man before the end of the day.

videos.title: Episode 80
videos.overview: Marius subconsciously pushes Carina away from him, while Beulah still fantasises about her and Wouter. Liam is unusually fragile after his previous session with Hanna but she insists on clearing one more matter with him. Kotie gives Gerhard a tough time and Stef makes a drastic decision…

videos.title: Episode 81
videos.overview: Carina reaches out to Marius but they find it very difficult to accomplish anything. At last Marius makes a decision but is it too late? Vicky struggles with the kiss between her and Marius and confides in Saskia who also has something to reveal.

videos.title: Episode 82
videos.overview: Marius and Carina’s love for each other is unmistakable, but the divide between them is so big. Stef returns from his bike trip and confronts Fritz and Saskia with shocking news.

videos.title: Episode 83

Saskia sets boundaries in her relationship with Stef, while Hanna attempts to do the same with Liam regarding their therapy sessions. Gerhard and Kotie decide a healthy diet isn’t enough - they also need exercise…

videos.title: Episode 96

videos.overview: Liam acts very strangely towards Hanna who finds it difficult to get a grip on her feelings for him. Stef tries in vain to convince Saskia that she is making a big mistake and he promises Fritz that Liam will never get the Villa shares.

videos.overview: Carina makes a final decision and resigns at Bakgat. Monique doesn’t keep her fondness of men a secret. Liam’s therapy sessions become more intense. Marius struggles to cope on his own in Bakgat.

videos.overview: Fritz makes sure that Liam leaves the Villa. Hanna fights for him without any success. Monique shares her story with Celine. Stef is reinstated at Van Romburg.

videos.overview: Marius wants to support Vicky during her pregnancy, but she’s still struggling to face the reality of it all. Celine feels Eben should tell everyone what’s bugging him, while Carina is worried about her studies.

videos.title: Episode 105

videos.overview: Eben struggles with his homosexuality, while Carina pleads with him to call their father and tell him the truth. Vicky secretly carries a fear, but then, finally, confides in Marius. Hanna confronts Liam with his terrible past. Stef decides to trump Liam.

videos.title: Episode 107
videos.overview: Marius and Vicky are stuck in their uncomfortable familiarity. When Carina finally explodes, the result is devastating.

videos.title: Episode 108
videos.overview: Once again Carina shows what a kind hearted person she is while Liam proves - once again - that he cannot stop himself from playing crooked games.

videos.title: Episode 109
videos.overview: Vicky goes to the doctor to find out whether her unborn child has the same disease that caused Milan’s death, with a heartbreaking revelation that awaits her.

videos.title: Episode 110
videos.overview: Saskia and Stef are uncomfortable in their relationship. Vincent continues to flatter the people in the Villa, but they start seeing through him. Hanna acts on the spur of the moment, making a decision about her and Liam. Meanwhile he sets a trap for Marius…

videos.title: Episode 111
videos.overview: Fritz warns Liam about his relationship with Hanna, but is Liam going to do what is expected from him? Saskia is clearly on a mission to change things in the Villa and is unaware that she upsets Lida.

videos.title: Episode 113
videos.overview: Vicky still struggles with her secret. Fritz is between the devil and the deep blue sea where the running of the Villa is concerned.

videos.title: Episode 114
videos.overview: Vicky shares her news with the Villa and Marius refuses to talk to anyone. Monique and Vincent’s plan is making progress while Saskia spends her time putting out fires.

videos.title: Episode 115
videos.overview: Marius gives up completely. Vicky makes the decision to save Bakgat and Eben agrees to help, but does he have his own plans to leave?

videos.title: Episode 116
videos.overview: Lida and Fritz are shocked at what they find in Liam’s office. Carina thanks Wouter for supporting Eben, but secretly still struggles to get Marius out of her system, not knowing what he’s up to with Liam. Monique shows up at Stef’s office yet again and Saskia sees red.

videos.title: Episode 117

videos.title: Episode 119
videos.overview: Marius wants to escape his drug dependency, but Liam makes it difficult. Celine suspects who the food thieves are. Celeste and Eben talk past each other.

videos.title: Episode 120
videos.overview: With the help of Wouter, Saskia begins to gain insight into the true vision for the Villa. Celeste puts Cardo in his place, while Celine begins to understand what’s upsetting Cardo.

videos.title: Episode 121
videos.overview: Marius lands in hot water and Liam plays his games with gusto. Vicky and Carina reach a milestone and Eben comes to surprise Vicky but his timing is way off.

videos.title: Episode 122

videos.title: Episode 124
videos.overview: Vicky and Carina are wracked with concern about Marius, while Liam subtly pushes him closer to his ruin. Stef puts Saskia on the spot when he confronts her about Vincent’s departure. Beulah decides to do a fashion make-over on Eben.

videos.title: Episode 125
videos.overview: Eben feels uncomfortable in a shirt Beulah bought him. Stef encourages Saskia to support Monique. Liam manipulates Marius into finally turning against all his friends.

videos.title: Episode 126
videos.overview: Marius and Liam’s unholy alliance is still going strong and it seems as if Liam is planning to take his devious scheme to new heights as Marius sinks to a new all time low.

videos.title: Episode 127

videos.title: Episode 128
videos.overview: Marius realises that Liam has led him to the edge of the abyss and that it’s impossible to save himself. But will he be able to prevent his loved ones from being compromised?

videos.overview: Cardo visits Wouter in jail and rubs salt in his wounds. Wouter is very relieved to see Stef, but an angry Stef is hesitant to help him. Saskia plans a romantic getaway and is not impressed with Stef’s reaction.

videos.title: Episode 130
videos.overview: Liam plays a nasty cat and mouse game with Marius, while pushing him closer to a final meltdown. Vicky presents Carina with an unexpected proposal. Monique departs in the shadow of a horrible and shattering revelation.

videos.title: Episode 131
videos.overview: Marius asks permission to move back into the Villa, but Fritz is not so keen. Saskia invites Stef and Vicky for dinner at her loft. Alex and Cardo has a business-chat.

videos.title: Episode 132
videos.overview: Bakgat’s future is still undecided and Marius is annoyed by the opinions on offer. Liam “helps” by creating more chaos and confusion.

videos.title: Episode 133
videos.overview: Marius struggles to kick his habit on his own. When he asks Liam for help, Liam exploits the situation for his own benefit. Liam expertly plays Marius's needs off against Vicky and Carina's goals. He wants to break any link between the two.

videos.title: Episode 134
videos.overview: Stef is frustrated with Saskia and her demands, but is hesitant to discuss it with Vicky. Marius forces Carina and Vicky to make a decision regarding the sale of Bakgat. Celine feels bad when she realises that she accused Alex falsely.

videos.title: Episode 135
videos.overview: Alex offers Celine a key to a new life, but it might have repercussions. Liam’s control over Marius leads, unknowingly, to a shocking incident for Carina and Vicky. Stef cuts Saskia down to size.

videos.title: Episode 136
videos.overview: Lida grieves over the loss of her deceased husband, and  Fritz consoles her. Vicky and Carina realise their support of Marius might not be as positive as they thought.

videos.title: Episode 137

videos.title: Episode 138
videos.overview: Marius and Liam return from a successful weekend away and he starts the healing process. Stef is worried about the pressure Fritz is under and the young guys receive an unpleasant surprise.

videos.title: Episode 139
videos.overview: While Saskia pulls out all the stops to control Stef, his relationship with Vicky grows stronger. Eben and Wouter are nervous to tell Fritz about the gay website. Cardo grows more paranoid in the light of his appearance in the pictures.

videos.title: Episode 140

videos.title: Episode 141
videos.overview: Eben asks Stef’s advice regarding the website while Cardo and Wouter tries their utmost to convince Eben not to abandon Brou Broers. Stef explains to Vicky why he had lunch with Saskia and is disappointed with her reaction.

videos.title: Episode 142
videos.overview: Saskia overhears a snippet between Stef and Vicky, which infuriates her. Liam manipulates Fritz to strenghten his reach for the shares of the Villa. Celine and Cardo are in love, but the shadow of Alex Kent hangs over their heads.

videos.title: Episode 143
videos.overview: Stef is on a mission to prevent Liam from getting hold of Marius’s Villa-shares. Gerhard and Kotie arrive unexpectedly at the Villa. Eben feels his privacy has been stolen from him. Cardo and Celine decide to pledge themselves to each other, without being in a relationship. Lida confesses her feelings for Fritz in a round-about way.

videos.overview: Fritz and Stef are at each other’s throats regarding Marius and the selling of his Villa shares. Vicky tries to make sense of the chaos that Liam refers to as his business and Saskia leads Stef to believe she’s on his side.

videos.title: Episode 145
videos.overview: Marius is determined to sell his shares to Liam, while Stef will stop at nothing to prevent that from happening. Gerhard refuses to indulge Kotie’s ridiculousness any longer, which drives him to seek comfort at the bar. The changes Celine has brought to Lida’s appearance seem to have the desired affect on Fritz.

videos.title: Episode 146
videos.overview: Stef is adamant not to let Liam become part of the Villa’s management and Vicky remains his only ally. Cardo tells Celine more about what happened during his childhood, and Wouter tries to cheer Carina up. Gerhard wins Kotie’s favour again, only to make another mistake…

videos.title: Episode 147
videos.overview: The youngsters stand together to help Marius through a very difficult time, but Vicky is not so sure about their plan. Vicky discovers something in Liam’s office that can potentially be a game changer but Stef is still doubtful.

videos.title: Episode 148
videos.overview: Saskia is hell bound to get Stef back in her life, and will try anything within her means to do so. Kotie has a new ace up her sleeve for Gerhard. While Marius is struggling with his drug demons, Liam tries to make contact.

videos.title: Episode 149
videos.overview: Gerhard is deeply unhappy as Kotie continues with her vegetable therapy. A desperate Saskia tries to keep Vicky and Stef from each other. Marius opens his heart to Carina, but she isn’t sure what to feel about his confession. Stef shares information with Saskia which causes her world to implode.

videos.title: Episode 150
videos.overview: Stef is brutally honest about his relationship with Saskia, which naturally incurs her wrath. She turns to Liam for assistance. Fritz returns amidst the excitement and he and Lida discuss matters of the heart.

videos.title: Episode 151
videos.overview: Jenny has an important matter she’d like to discuss, which puts pressure on Marius and Vicky. Saskia is desperate and tries to enlist the help of Liam, but he plays by his own rules. Stef gains new hope from an unexpected ally. Gerhard and Kotie’s relationship is on uncertain ground.

videos.title: Episode 152
videos.overview: Saskia is livid with Liam but realises that he is her only lifeline while Liam uses the tension between Saskia and Stef to his advantage.

videos.title: Episode 153
videos.overview: It’s Christmas eve and Fritz only wants peace and quiet, but Saskia is on a mission to ruin the day. Jenny leaves, Marius reaches out to Vicky, and Carina, without realizing, gives Wouter new hope.

videos.title: Episode 154

Liam wants to be an official shareholder, but Saskia makes it difficult. Marius is slowly winning Carina’s trust again.

videos.title: Episode 155
videos.overview: Carina has a crisis of conscience about the previous night’s kiss. Vicky rediscovers what motherhood entails and Fritz organises a dinner to celebrate Louw’s return.

videos.title: Episode 156
videos.overview: Marius doesn’t know which way to turn and everyone tries to keep their distance from him. Vicky and Carina find it especially difficult to deal with his relapse

videos.title: Episode 157
videos.overview: Marius greets the Villa. Gerhard and Kotie fail in their mission in spite of Cardo’s good advice. Cardo has good news for Brou Broers but it puts strain on his friendship with Celine. Fritz battles with the latest unexpected event in his life and Vicky fights against her feelings of guilt after doing the right thing.

videos.title: Episode 158
videos.overview: Several people reach out to Carina, but she wants to be left alone. Vicky is struggling to cope with Louw being back and Marius away, but Stef gives her the support she needs. Kotie tries to save her tattoo and when that doesn’t work, she wants to get rid of it. Saskia tries to break free from Liam’s hold on her and approaches Stef…

Vicky feels guilty that she did not treat Carina with enough empathy and Stef tries his best to show Vicky that she can always rely on him. Saskia makes another attempt to save her friendship with Vicky and when Koties makes an admission, Gerhard is convinced that his life is in danger.

videos.overview: Carina tries to face the world but doesn’t necessarily like what she sees. Kotie makes a swift departure and nearly sends Gerhard into the afterlife once more. Saskia accepts Liam’s help and automatically finds herself in a precarious position as a result.

videos.title: Episode 162

Vicky is excited about her new venture with Liam and decides to show Stef how she feels about him. Liam pressures Saskia to pull her weight and Fritz explains his intention behind Lida’s gift.

Wouter tries to bring their friendship circle closer together, while simultaneously trying to cheer up Carina. Lida has reached a turning point

Liam plays a cat and mouse game with Vicky, putting her under pressure. Saskia gets the shock of her life when she opens her front door.

Carina makes an announcement.

videos.title: Episode 170

videos.title: Episode 171
videos.overview: Liam has his hands full with the two sisters who are constantly in each others’s hair but manages to pacify Monique for the time being with a gift. Wouter still believes that Carina is trying her best to avoid him and is even more confused after confronting her.

videos.title: Episode 172
videos.overview: Monique shares her new insights with Liam and Saskia discovers something really shocking. Liam has to put out fires and finds it tough to control his temper with the two feuding sisters. Fritz is caught up in a difficult situation and battles to decide what to do about it.

Fritz prevents Neels from taking Lida out to lunch. More tension builds between Wouter and Carina. Eben tries to have a closer friendship with Wouter, but he realizes it won’t be easy.

Little does Fritz know that his admiration will turn into resentment in the near future.  Saskia reckons she has Stef right where she wants him - until Liam points out the absolute blunder that she has made

videos.title: Episode 176
videos.overview: Liam is angry with Saskia’s reluctance to continue with their plans. There is serious tension between Carina, Wouter and Eben and Celine feels it is her duty to restore the peace.

videos.title: Episode 178

videos.title: Episode 180

Liam increases the pressure on Saskia and she tries to fight back, but will she ever be her own woman again?

videos.title: Episode 182

videos.title: Episode 183

Celine and Stef helps him to admit this, but convincing him to act on those feelings seems an impossible task.

videos.title: Episode 185
videos.overview: Liam is focussed on finding the precious coins, which leads him to the Villa’s cellar. Fritz comes clean, telling Neels and Lida he would not attend their wedding, but the is then overcome with an emotion, which projects him to do something shocking.

videos.title: Episode 186

Stef and Saskia are getting closer, while Vicky decides that perhaps she should move on too. Cardo gets an unexpected visitor that makes him and Celine very tense.

videos.title: Episode 187
